Fast, secure in-person document signing
Need signatures on the spot but want to avoid delays and frustration? Eliminate delays, modernize the in-person signing process, and get the best of both worlds—capturing signatures digitally while maintaining that all-important personal touch.
On-the-spot signatures made simple, fast, and personable
In-Person Signing combines the speed of eSignatures with the convenience of in-person interactions. Enhance your customer experiences with a modern and seamless digital experience.
Allow Signers to Sign Documents Instantly on Their Devices

With Blueink's In-Person Signing, signers can use their own devices—be it a smartphone, tablet, or laptop—to sign documents instantly. This flexibility not only speeds up the process but also enhances the signer's convenience, ensuring a smoother and more efficient interaction. No more waiting for printouts or dealing with cumbersome paperwork; signatures can be captured in real time, right where you are.

Maintain Personal Interaction While Avoiding Clunky Printouts and Paperwork

Keep the personal touch of face-to-face meetings without the hassle of managing physical documents. Blueink allows you to engage directly with signers, maintaining the essential personal connection, while digitally handling all the document signing. This approach eliminates the need for clunky printouts, streamlining your workflow and reducing clutter.

Control the Signing Experience and Minimize Errors in Real Time

Take control of the signing process with Blueink's real-time oversight capabilities. Guide signers through the document, ensuring each required field is completed accurately. This hands-on approach minimizes errors, prevents omissions, and ensures that the signing process is both smooth and error-free. Immediate correction of mistakes enhances the overall efficiency and reliability of document signing.

Capture Audit Trails and Provide Signer Authentication Options

Every action taken during the signing process is recorded, providing a comprehensive log for legal and regulatory purposes. Additionally, you can utilize various authentication methods, such as SMS codes or email verification, to confirm the signer's identity, ensuring the integrity and security of your documents.

FAQs
How do I enable the In-Person Signing feature in Blueink?

To enable the In-Person Signing feature in Blueink, log in to your account and select a template or use the "prepare and send" option. Navigate to the "Signer" section, click on “Enable In-Person Signing,” and toggle it on.

How do I conduct an in-person signing session with Blueink?

To conduct an in-person signing session with Blueink, arrange a meeting with the signer(s) at a convenient location. During the meeting, open the document on a device with BlueInk access, such as a tablet or laptop, and allow the signer(s) to review and sign the document.

Can I use the In-Person Signing feature with the Disable Signing Notifications option?

Yes, you can use the In-Person Signing feature in conjunction with the Disable Signing Notifications option in Blueink. This allows you to sign documents directly from the dashboard without needing to send the document via email. Both options can be enabled for any signer who will be signing in person via the BlueInk dashboard.

What are the benefits of enabling the In-Person Signing feature in Blueink?

Enabling the In-Person Signing feature in Blueink enhances the flexibility and convenience of your document signing process. It allows you to facilitate face-to-face signings while still enjoying the benefits of a digital signature solution, ensuring a seamless and efficient signing experience.
